title: Settings
desc: Configure defaults, engines, the external API, and view diagnostics.
lede: Settings is where you configure Studio: general defaults, engines, the external API, and diagnostics.
body:
At a glance
  • General: safe mode, default engine/speaker.
  • Engines: enable, configure, install/update, delete.
  • API panel; About/diagnostics.

General

Set project-wide defaults like safe mode and the default engine/speaker.

Engines

Enable, configure, install, update, and delete engines. Updates surface here as a notify-only alert with per-engine and Update-all actions. See Engine Settings & Verification and Installing & Updating Engines.

API panel

Enable and manage the TTS Gateway API. See Gateway Overview.

About / diagnostics

Check versions and diagnostics when you need to confirm what's installed or troubleshoot.
